fullPassage: Our skin conducts electricity more or less efficiently, depending on our emotions. We know that when we're emotionally stimulated — stressed, sad, any intense emotion, really — our bodies sweat a tiny bit, so little we might not even notice. And when those tiny drops of sweat appear, our skin gets more electrically conductive. This change in sweat gland activity happens completely without our conscious mind having much say in the matter. If you feel emotionally intense, you're going to notice an increase in sweat gland activity. This is particularly useful from a scientific viewpoint, because it allows us to put an objective value on a subjective state of mind. We can actually measure your emotional state by tracking how your body subconsciously sweats, by running a bit of electricity through your skin. We can then turn the subjective, subconscious experience of emotional intensity into an objective number by figuring out how good your skin gets at transferring an electrical current.

questions.passage: Our skin conducts electricity more or less efficiently, depending on our emotions. We know that when we're emotionally stimulated — stressed, sad, any intense emotion, really — our bodies sweat a tiny bit, so little we might not even notice. And when those tiny drops of sweat appear, our skin gets more electrically conductive. This change in sweat gland activity happens completely without our conscious mind having much say in the matter. If you feel emotionally intense, you're going to notice an increase in sweat gland activity. This is particularly useful from a scientific viewpoint, because it allows us to <u>put an objective value on a subjective state of mind</u>. We can actually measure your emotional state by tracking how your body subconsciously sweats, by running a bit of electricity through your skin. We can then turn the subjective, subconscious experience of emotional intensity into an objective number by figuring out how good your skin gets at transferring an electrical current.
questions.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 <u>put an objective value on a subjective state of mind</u>가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① objective value = 수치, subjective state of mind = 감정 경험 → 감정을 과학적으로 측정
❌ ② 냉정한 사고가 아닌 과학적 측정에 대한 내용
❌ ③ 금전적 환산과 무관 (value = 측정값)
❌ ④ 언어적 전달이 아닌 전기전도도를 통한 수치 측정
det.tip: 'put a value on'은 '~에 가치를 부여하다/측정하다'라는 뜻입니다. 여기서 value는 금전적 가치가 아닌 측정값입니다.
